note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, authored none of 9c3697d0d1). RFC 7606 Section 3(g): "If the MP_REACH_NLRI attribute or the MP_UNREACH_NLRI [RFC4760] attribute appears more than once in the UPDATE message, then a NOTIFICATION message MUST be sent with the Error Subcode "Malformed Attribute List"." The only change to TestRFC7606Section3gDuplicateMPBeatsAnAbandonedWalk is a doc-comment rename (ValidateUpdateRFC7606AddPath to ValidateUpdateRFC7606Peer). Re-read the body: two MP_REACH (EVPN with reachable NLRI, then ipv4 10.0.0.0/24) followed by an AS_PATH declaring 64 octets with none present; the abandoned walk alone is treat-as-withdraw because reachable NLRI exists, so only the duplicate can yield the asserted exact SessionReset plus error, which isolates 3(g). The 3/1 subcode is asserted by the session-level carriers (TestSessionRFC7606SessionResetNotification, TestSessionRFC7606DuplicateMPUnreachNotificationOnTheWire), and single-MP controls stay accepted. Producer ValidateUpdateRFC7606Peer's in-loop duplicate reset is unchanged by 9c3697d0d1. Unit ran green at HEAD.
